info.name: MVMNT Teams API
info.description:
The MVMNT API enables you to automate freight brokerage workflows by integrating
directly with our Transportation Management System.

Contact Support:
 Name: MVMNT Support
 Email: support@mvmnt.io

request.description:
Filter teams using comprehensive query criteria with AND/OR logic and multiple operators.
Supports complex filtering similar to GraphQL capabilities.
Note: Soft-deleted teams are excluded by default (deletedAt defaults to { isNull: true }).
